brief:
Hamas welcomed a joint statement issued Monday by the foreign ministers of the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Jordan, and Indonesia, according to Shehab Wire. The Islamic Resistance Movement called for binding the Israeli occupation to implement a road map, though details of the diplomatic initiative remained unclear from the initial announcement.

The coordinated statement represents a rare alignment among the regional and Muslim-majority nations on Palestinian affairs. Hamas's endorsement signals the movement's receptiveness to multilateral diplomatic efforts, even as the specifics of the proposed road map were not disclosed in the report.
